EC1: Renal disease  [NOT] unrelated to SLE (e.g. diabetes mellitus [OR], other glomerular [OR] or tubulointerstitial disease [OR], renovascular disease) [OR], or transplanted kidney.
EC2: Estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR by MDRD) =20 mL/min per 1.73 m2 [OR]  or serum creatinine >300 micromol/L (3.39 mg/dL) at screening.
EC3: Renal biopsy showing cellular [OR] or fibrocellular crescent in more than 25% of glomeruli.
EC4: CNS [OR] or other severe organ manifestation of lupus [AND] that necessitate aggressive immunosuppressive therapy on its own.
EC5: Co-morbidities [AND] that require corticosteroid therapy (e.g. asthma [OR], inflammatory bowel disease).
EC6: Treatment with prednisolone ([OR]or prednisone [OR], or equivalent) at >20 mg/D for over 4 weeks within the past 3 months.
EC7: Treatment with MMF at >1.5 g/D for over 4 weeks within the past 3 months.
EC8: Known hypersensitivity [OR] or intolerability to prednisolone ([OR] or prednisone [OR], or equivalent), TAC [OR], or MMF at a dose of 1.25 g or below per day.
EC9: Subjects who are already on treatment with TAC [OR], cyclosporine [OR] or any other calcineurin inhibitor for over 4 weeks within the past 12 months.
EC10: Treatment with cyclophosphamide [OR], leflunomide [OR], or methotrexate for over 2 weeks [OR], or use of biological agent(s) regardless of duration, within the past 6 months (Note: prior use of [NOT] azathioprine [OR], mizoribine [OR], intravenous immunoglobulins and anti-malarials is allowed).
EC11: Uncontrolled hypertension with systolic BP >160 mmHg [OR] or diastolic BP >95 mmHg.
EC12: Women who are pregnant [OR] or breastfeeding.
EC13: Women with childbearing potential or their male partners, who refuse to use an effective birth control method
